rv.t: Have owned this practically for its whole life. Each time is usually several years removed from the last and is just as much fun and challenging each time. I am 79 now so it does take me longer to get through to gold on each story.

After nearly two decades this is still the pinnacle of Tower Defense games in terms of strategy and consistency. Each new wave builds on the last meaning you can measure the effect of each new tower or upgrade on each new wave. …

Game used to be fun for a bit. Controls are time controls pretty outdated now. Also developed a problem when you close the game it will keep fullscreen and stay on top of all other applications and the desktop. …
